disposition_reason: Prints nickel, lead, chromium and cadmium in leaf, stem and root of home-grown fenugreek and spinach under control and metal-treated soils.

study.design: Pot experiment: fenugreek and spinach grown at home in plain soil and soil treated with 5-20 ppm of Ni, Pb, Cr or Cd
study.origin: Home-grown, Bhopal area, India (location of growing not stated beyond 'at home')
study.method: Microwave HNO3/H2O2 digestion of 0.5 g wet ground tissue; ICP-MS (Agilent 7700) with internal standards
study.qa: Multi-element calibration standards and internal standard mix; no CRM or recovery data reported despite conclusion claiming good recovery
